warrington.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Warrington and Cheshire
s1loc: Warrington runs a busy live-events calendar. Parr Hall on Palmyra Square is the town's surviving professional concert hall, paired with the Pyramid Arts Centre under Culture Warrington for music, comedy and theatre, while grassroots band nights and the Comedy Store fill the smaller rooms. Outdoors, Neighbourhood Weekender brings indie headliners to Victoria Park each May, and Creamfields turns the Daresbury Estate into one of the country's biggest dance festivals, putting large seasonal crews on the ground across Cheshire.

And the trade runs at every size. Major venues, festival operators and production companies field big crews and large seasonal teams and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers around Warrington and the wider Cheshire towns need just a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier here has to serve the big festival and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side.

newport.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Newport and Gwent
s1loc: Newport has a proud live-music story. The Riverfront on Bristol Packet Wharf, beside the River Usk, is the city's main theatre and arts centre, with the Newport Centre long serving as the town's bigger concert and event hall. The grassroots heritage runs deep too: the legendary TJ's on Clarence Place launched bands from the Manic Street Preachers outward under John Sicolo. Each July the Big Splash street-theatre festival turns the Riverfront and the city streets into an outdoor stage.
